method: Fresh isolated Assessment A; original checker design rubric and HisabIQ taste/brief. No c4 audit/detector or agent inventory read. Captures reviewed directly, no source edits.
summary: Approved HisabIQ identity, compact controls, complete routine desktop totals and phone product identities are preserved. Strong theme parity and readable localized dialogs. Dense supported multi-unit desktop carts still push essential columns off the initial view; selected-unit text truncates.

problems.title: Dense multi-unit desktop cart still hides price/total/remove columns
problems.evidence: T2/T5/T6/T8: round-3-3units-1440-light.png and dark, round-3-4units-1440-light.png and dark show 6-line supported cart at scrollLeft=0 with right edge cutting price header/cells; line totals and remove controls outside initial cart viewport. Routine round-3-main-desktop shots are fixed. Named horizontal scrolling supplies recovery, but the aligned complete desktop-cart brief is only partially met.
problems.suggestion: Keep total/remove visible in dense supported desktop states while retaining the joined quantity field and compact original layout.

problems.title: Selected price unit becomes an ambiguous P… on dense desktop rows
problems.evidence: T2/T5/T6: round-3-4units-1440-light.png and dark show both three/four-unit Price in dropdown values as P… instead of complete pcs/Pack; 320px counterparts show complete symbols. This obscures the unit governing the adjacent editable price.
problems.suggestion: Reserve the full short unit symbol in the selected trigger.

strengths: Product-specific Bengali/English counter workflow and blue/teal language remain intact.
Main 1440px cart exposes totals and remove; phone full main identities and very large payable values remain readable.
Serial and vendor errors are adjacent, legible and localized; installment adjustment menu matches both themes.
